verdict.rationale: Foreloop has its own in-product agent: an intention's agent reads a feedback submission, fills in the intention, and proposes tasks. The actual task execution, however, is handed to external agents (Claude Code or Codex) that the user runs on their own machine, so the built-in assistant only drafts and plans work rather than carrying out delegated tasks. Missing for 10: a documented built-in assistant that executes delegated tasks inside the product, an interactive way to hand arbitrary tasks to it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
You run an agent — Claude Code or Codex — in a checkout of your repository on your own machine.
